verdict.rationale: Modal's own docs describe Sandboxes as "secure containers for executing untrusted user or agent code" and "isolated" environments, and list a "VM Sandboxes Beta" guide section, which points to a VM-level boundary option. However, the evidence never documents the isolation mechanism (microVM, gVisor or similar), and the VM option appears only as a beta heading. missing for 10: explicit documentation of the isolation technology and its threat model, GA status for the VM-based isolation option, independent or hands-on corroboration of the isolation boundary.
